story_theme_en: A shirt costs 850 baht. The mall gives a 25% discount. How much do you pay? How much is the discount in baht? If you have a membership card that gives an additional 10% off the discounted price, how much do you pay?
helper_tip: Discount amount = (discount% / 100) × original price. Final price = original price - discount.
hint_th: ส่วนลด = (ร้อยละ/100) × ราคาเต็ม ราคาหลังลด = ราคาเต็ม - ส่วนลด
